choices.reasoning: Discarding Surveillance Team (option 2). It is the least immediately useful card in hand: it requires counters to function and only removes 1 threat per 3 counters, but we have no counters on the board yet. All other cards are more directly valuable for turn 1: Backflip prevents all damage from an attack, Mockingbird provides an attacking ally with a stun, Aunt May heals 4 damage in alter-ego form, and Interrogation Room/Spider-Tracer offer threat removal that can be used once minions are engaged. Keeping Surveillance Team would waste hand space on a support that cannot be played until counters accumulate, while the other cards directly contribute to surviving the villain's attack or defeating Rhino.

Discarding Interrogation Room (option 6). It is the least immediately useful card in the current hand. Both it and Spider-Tracer require a minion to be defeated before they can remove threat, but Interrogation Room only removes 1 threat per minion defeat, while Spider-Tracer removes 3. Since we have no minions on the board yet and threat management is important (threshold 7), keeping the more powerful threat-removal card Spider-Tracer is better. All other remaining cards are more immediately useful: Backflip prevents all damage from an attack, Mockingbird provides an attacking ally with a stun, Aunt May heals 4 damage in alter-ego form, and Spider-Tracer can remove 3 threat when a minion is defeated.

Discarding Spider-Tracer (option 5). It is the least immediately useful card remaining in hand. While it can remove 3 threat from a scheme when a minion is defeated, that requires a minion to be present on the board first, and we have no minions yet. The other remaining cards are more directly useful: Backflip prevents all damage from an attack (critical for surviving the villain's attack in alter-ego form), Mockingbird provides an attacking ally with a thwart and a stun, Aunt May heals 4 damage in alter-ego form, and Spider-Tracer is the weakest of the four — its threat removal only becomes useful after a minion is defeated, which is not yet possible.

Discarding Aunt May (option 3). It is the least immediately useful card remaining in hand. While Aunt May provides a heal of 4 damage in alter-ego form, the current priority is to survive the villain's attack and deal damage to Rhino. Backflip is the most valuable card — it can completely prevent all damage from an attack, which is critical for staying alive. Mockingbird is also very useful as an attacking ally with a thwart and a stun. Keeping Aunt May would waste a slot on a support that cannot be used until we switch back to alter-ego form (where its heal action becomes available), but at that point we'd already have Backflip and Mockingbird for the early game. Discarding Aunt May leaves us with the three most impactful cards: Backflip (damage prevention), Mockingbird (board presence with attack/thwart/stun), and the remaining resources to play them.

Discarding Mockingbird (option 2). Keep Backflip. Backflip is the most valuable card in hand — it prevents all damage from an attack, which is critical for surviving Rhino's attack as an alter-ego form. Without it, I would take damage from the villain's attack. Mockingbird, while useful as a board presence ally, can be replaced by other means (e.g., Aunt May's heal if we switch to alter-ego form later). Backflip is a one-time-use interrupt that completely nullifies an attack, making it irreplaceable in the early game.

Keeping Backflip as the only remaining card in hand. It is the most valuable card for surviving the villain's attack as an alter-ego form — it prevents all damage from an attack via its interrupt ability. With no other cards to play, keeping Backflip ensures I can block Rhino's attack safely and deal damage to the villain on my turn.

Change form to Spider-Man (hero form) as the first action of this turn. Currently in alter-ego form, the villain attacks us with Rhino's ATK 2. Changing to hero form allows us to attack with our basic power and prevents the villain from scheming against us. After changing form, we can use Backflip to defend against the incoming attack (if needed), then attack as a hero. This is the optimal sequence: change form first, then defend and attack.

Use the basic power as Spider-Man to deal 2 damage to Rhino. As a hero in hero form, I can attack with my basic power. This is the optimal play: deal damage to the villain while in hero form (where I can attack and thwart), then end the turn. The attack deals 2 damage to Rhino's HP (from 14 to 12).

End the turn with Backflip in hand. The turn is complete: I attacked as Spider-Man dealing 2 damage to Rhino (12 HP remaining). Ending the turn allows the villain phase to proceed, after which I can change back to alter-ego form to defend against Rhino's attack and continue managing threat.

Discard Black Cat. Black Cat is an ally that attacks (atk 1) and thwarts (thw 1), plus stuns an enemy on entry. While useful for board control, it's less immediately valuable than the other remaining cards. Forge Justice! is critical for threat management (removes 3 threat from a scheme, or 4 if paid with a mental resource). Web-Shooter generates wild resources that can be used to pay for cards. Avengers Mansion draws a card when exhausted — useful for drawing new cards. Energy is a resource that can be discarded. Black Cat's attack power (1) is the weakest among the allies, and its stun effect is situational. Discarding it frees up hand space for more impactful cards.

My hand has 5 cards and hand_size is 5, so no further discards are needed. The discard pile already contains 6 cards (the original 5 discarded plus Black Cat). I can confirm the discard and draw up to hand size (drawing 0 cards), which will reset my hand to its full size of 5 for the next turn.

Defend with Spider-Man (exhaust; DEF 3 reduces the damage). The villain's attack has base ATK 2 plus a boost card. Even with the boost card adding up to 2 icons, the damage is at most 4 − 3 = 1 HP. Without defense, I would take at least 2 damage (or more if the boost card has more icons). Defending with Spider-Man minimizes damage taken. After defending, Spider-Man draws 1 card via the Spider-Sense ability.

End the turn now. The round is ending and the villain phase is about to begin. Threat has already been added (total 3, below the threshold of 7). The Hydra Mercenary will attack Spider-Man, but defending with Backflip will reduce the damage to 0 (ATK 1 + boost +1 = 2, DEF 3). By ending the turn now, I keep my hero form for round 3, where I can attack as Spider-Man and deal 2 damage to Rhino (12 → 10), continuing to chip away at the villain's HP.

Discard Black Cat. Black Cat is an ally that attacks and thwarts, but it's less immediately useful than the other remaining cards. For Justice! is critical for threat management — it removes 3 threat from a scheme (the main scheme is at 3 threat, threshold 7). Using it now would bring the threat to 0, giving a buffer of 4 more rounds before reaching the threshold. Black Cat's attack power (1) and stun effect are less valuable than the threat removal provided by For Justice!.

Confirm the discard of Black Cat. The hand already has 5 cards (Web-Shooter, For Justice!, Avengers Mansion, Energy, Enhanced Spider-Sense), which matches the hand size limit. No further discards are needed. Keeping For Justice! is critical for threat management — it removes 3 threat from a scheme, and the main scheme is at threat 1 with a threshold of 7. Using it on round 3 will bring the threat to 0, giving a buffer of 4 more rounds before reaching the threshold. Discarding For Justice! would waste this powerful threat-removal ability.

Defend with Spider-Man (exhaust; DEF 3 reduces the damage). The boost card Caught Off Guard adds +1 to the attack, so the total damage is 2 (base ATK) + 1 (boost icon) = 3. With DEF 3, the damage is reduced to 0. Taking the damage would be a waste of HP and could leave me too low to survive future rounds. Defending with Backflip is the optimal choice to prevent all damage from this attack.

Play Enhanced Spider-Sense to cancel the When Revealed effect of the Gang-Up treachery. The surge attack deals damage to Spider-Man (1 damage), but cancelling it prevents this damage and preserves HP. With Spider-Man at 10 HP, preserving health is critical for surviving the remaining rounds against Rhino's attacks.

Pay with Avengers Mansion (mental resource) to play Enhanced Spider-Sense. Removing 3 threat would bring it to -1 (effectively 0), giving a buffer of 4 more rounds before reaching the threshold of 7. Play Web-Shooter, paying with Emergency (energy). This allows me to play Avengers Mansion next turn, which will draw a card and help me continue playing. Play Avengers Mansion to draw a card and refresh my hand. This allows me to continue playing cards in future turns while I attack as Spider-Man in round 3. The drawn card may provide additional resources or actions to help deal with Rhino's attacks and the minion engagement.

Play Interrogation Room to remove 3 threat from the main scheme. Pay with Interrogation Room (energy) to play Spider-Tracer targeting Hydra Mercenary. The cost of Spider-Tracer is 1 energy, and Interrogation Room provides the required energy resource for payment.
